cost_of_revenue.label_verbatim: Substantially all of cost of revenue consists of compute and infrastructure costs associated with customer-serving workloads. Additionally, cost of revenue includes certain personnel-related costs and allocated overhead costs.

research_and_development.label_verbatim: Research and development expenses primarily consist of compute and infrastructure costs associated with model development, research, and internal usage workloads, personnel-related costs, software expenses, and allocated overhead costs.

sales_and_marketing.label_verbatim: Sales and marketing expenses primarily consist of channel partner costs, marketing and advertising, personnel-related costs, compute and infrastructure costs associated with providing free access to the Company's intelligence service, and allocated overhead costs.

general_and_administrative.label_verbatim: General and administrative expenses primarily consist of the Company's donation matching obligation, personnel-related costs, facility costs, allocated overhead costs, legal fees, and non-income-based taxes.

presentation_change.label_verbatim: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company changed its presentation of operating expenses from a functional classification under which cost of revenue, gross profit (loss), research and development, sales and marketing, and general and administrative were presented as separate line items, to a classification based on the nature of expenses.

definition.label_verbatim: Compute and infrastructure expenses primarily consist of costs attributable to operating our technology infrastructure, which supports the full range of workloads for our models, including research, model development, serving customers, and internal usage of Claude.

expensed_when_available.label_verbatim: These expenses are paid and recognized as compute becomes available to us, rather than when committed, and are generally fixed in the near term

procured_ahead.label_verbatim: the majority of our compute is contracted under multi-year commitments that we typically procure 12 to 18 months in advance of availability.

short_term_compute_margin_warning.label_verbatim: We expect our use of short-term compute to increase in the near term and to in turn compress our operating margin and Adjusted Operating Margin as a result.

lease_depreciation_from_2026.label_verbatim: Beginning in 2026, as our obligations commence under compute and infrastructure leases, these expenses also include operating lease costs, amortization of finance lease assets, variable lease costs, and depreciation and amortization on owned servers, networking equipment, and related data center assets.

chip_families.label_verbatim: We train and serve Claude natively across four major chip families (AWS Trainium, Google TPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, and AMD GPUs)

anthropic_direct.label_verbatim: we are shifting from sourcing compute solely through fixed-term cloud agreements to a hybrid model that also includes leasing chips directly and hosting them in dedicated facilities operated on our behalf. We refer to this additional source of compute as Anthropic Direct

compute_supplier_concentration.label_verbatim: Prior to 2026, the Company obtained substantially all of its compute infrastructure from three cloud service providers ("CSPs"). During the six months ended June 30, 2026 (unaudited), the Company obtained a substantial majority of its compute infrastructure from a limited number of CSPs and other suppliers

adjusted_operating_income_definition.label_verbatim: We define Adjusted Operating Income (Loss) as operating loss excluding (i) stock-based compensation expense, (ii) non-cash charitable contributions, and (iii) the Bartz settlement. adjusted_net_income_definition.label_verbatim: We define Adjusted Net Income (Loss) as net loss excluding (i) stock-based compensation expense, (ii) non-cash charitable contributions, (iii) the Bartz settlement, (iv) the change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs, and (v) change in fair value of certain mark-to-market financial instruments.
